tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the top bar, the sidebar, the tab bar, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: segmented control track, the salary row, inactive invoice tiles.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around secondary buttons. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: input borders, the unchecked bill circle. 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a progress bar or meter.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, the currency prefix and cents, on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Text of 24px or larger only (the year in the month title), placeholder glyphs and the neutral bar segment. 3:1 on bg and surface; too light for small text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary button, FAB, selected day, your share in a split bar. Fill only; pair with on-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Blue as text or icon on bg, surface and primary-soft: links, the open-invoice badge, icon tiles.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info badges, icon tiles and the area under the invoice chart.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: First segment of the salary breakdown bar (the household half), next to primary.

tokens.name: partner
tokens.usage: The second person in the couple: their avatar, legend dot and share of a split bar. Close in lightness to primary, so always label it with the person's name.

tokens.name: on-partner
tokens.usage: Text on partner.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Fill for what is left over or within budget: the leftover bar segment, a paid check, the housing meter. Fill only.

tokens.name: positive-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text on bg, surface and positive-soft: leftover amount, available limit, percentage of salary free.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a paid badge.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Estimated amounts (prefixed with ≈) and the estimate badge text, on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the estimate badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Notification count and destructive button fill. Pair with on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Negative balances, overdue labels and field errors on bg, surface and danger-soft. Same lightness as positive-ink, so a negative amount also carries a minus sign.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an overdue badge.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The active tab pill and the dark credit-card face.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on inverse.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: The one hero balance per screen.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: The total at the top of a card.

styles.name: amount-md
styles.usage: Totals inside a card and on phone screens.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The month in the top bar.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row amounts, button labels, selected items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Supporting lines under an amount, legend labels, hints.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a sub-section inside a card.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; gap between bar segments is half of this.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling controls and between day chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a list row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; screen gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between a card's header block and its content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, day chips, badges on a card face.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Wells and tiles inside a card, icon tiles, the credit-card face.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the top bar, the sidebar, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: badges, bars, avatars, the tab bar and the FAB.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards and the selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things that float above the page: tab bar, FAB, dialogs, toasts.
